hypothesis: For the 6-step, 3-compiler autocatalytic-artwork world of the companion paper *Autocatalytic Artwork* (papers/autocatalytic_artwork/paper.md), with specification alphabet |S|=4, experience alphabet |E|=4, candidate compiler family {K_a (diagonal 0.85/0.05), K_b (shifted 0.85/0.05), K_c (uniform 0.25)}, true compiler K_a, uniform prior mu_0=(1/3,1/3,1/3), and 200 seeded Mulberry32 runs, Theorem AA-1 predicts (a) the audience's mean analytical expected one-step predictive log-likelihood LL_t = E_{s,e ~ P_S x K_a}[log K̄_μ_t(e|s)] is non-decreasing in t from t=0 through t=6, and (b) the mean posterior mass on the true compiler K_a at t=6 is at least 0.9. Theorem AA-2 predicts (c) the Bayesian update mu_{t+1}(theta) proportional to mu_t(theta) K_theta(e_t|s_t) is exactly the Boltzmann compiler-ecology update of Theorem CT-2 with reward r_t(theta)=log K_theta(e_t|s_t) and beta=1, so a parallel Boltzmann trajectory agrees with the Bayesian trajectory to 1e-12 on every (t, theta, seed). Companion gate (d): at t=6 the Bayesian-audience expected LL exceeds the frozen uniform-baseline expected LL by at least 0.1 nats.

gates.AAP_AA1_PREDICTIVE_LOG_LIKELIHOOD_NON_DE: Mean over 200 seeded runs of the analytical expected predictive log-likelihood LL_t = E_{s,e ~ P_S x K_a}[log K̄_μ_t(e|s)] is non-decreasing in t from t=0 through t=N_STEPS=6, with 1e-6 tolerance for finite-run noise on the per-posterior functional.
gates.AAP_AA1_POSTERIOR_CONCENTRATES_ON_TRUE_C: Mean over 200 runs of mu_6(K_a) is at least 0.9.
gates.AAP_AA2_REDUCES_TO_COMPILER_ECOLOGY: Maximum absolute per-theta gap between the Bayesian and Boltzmann-equivalent posteriors across all 200 runs and 7 belief snapshots is at most 1e-12.
gates.AAP_AA_AUDIENCE_BEATS_UNIFORM_BASELINE: At t=6, the mean Bayesian-audience expected LL exceeds the frozen uniform-baseline expected LL by at least 0.1 nats.

compute.sampling: seeded Mulberry32 pseudo-random for the trajectory (200 seeds x 7 held-out samples); exact analytical LL computation over the 16 (s,e) pairs per posterior; no Monte Carlo variance in the LL estimator's inner expectation.
